notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Zealous Conscripts that is tapped and attacking.
When the Zealous Conscripts token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
